title: Aurum Alpha browser runtime configuration document
description: The document a server renders from its own environment and serves to the browser at load, so the bundle itself stays environment-agnostic. Governed by standards/web-client.md WC2. This document is served to every anonymous visitor and is therefore PUBLIC BY CONSTRUCTION — a value that must not be public belongs behind the BFF, never here. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

schema_version.description: Pins the shape so a client served a newer document by an older server, or the reverse, fails loudly rather than reading a field that moved (PC6).

environment.description: Which environment served this bundle. The bundle is identical across all of them (WC2); this is how the running client knows where it landed.

api_base_url.description: Origin the API client (WC3) calls. Under the WC1 default this is the BFF's own origin, so requests are same-origin and the session cookie is sent without CORS credentials handling.

auth.description: How this client authenticates. Under WC1's default the browser holds no token and needs no provider details — only where to start and end a session.

pattern.description: Which RFC 10017 pattern this application uses. 'bff' is the fleet default; the other two require a stated reason in the repository's Conventions (WC1).

login_path.description: Path the client navigates to in order to begin a login. A top-level navigation, not a fetch — the OIDC provider must be able to render its own UI and redirect back.

logout_path.description: Path that ends the session. Ending it is the server's job under WC1, because the credential is an HttpOnly cookie the browser cannot clear itself.

build.description: What the browser is running. These are the two values WC2 permits to be compiled into the bundle, because they describe the build rather than the environment — the browser's half of service.md SC5. They are echoed here so a client can detect that it is running a bundle older than the one the server now serves.

version.description: The application version this bundle was built as.

commit.description: The full commit the bundle was built from. Required in every error report (WC5), because a stack trace against unknown source is unreadable.

features.description: Per-environment toggles the client reads at load. Present so that a toggle is never a reason to rebuild the bundle, which is the WC2 failure this document exists to prevent. The evaluation contract itself belongs to the feature flags standard, not here.
